sourceTitle: Bel Ami; Or, The History of a Scoundrel: A Novel
description: "Bel Ami; Or, The History of a Scoundrel: A Novel" by Guy de Maupassant is a literary work written in the late 19th century. The novel centers on Georges Duroy, a young man who struggles with poverty and seeks to improve his social standing in Paris through cunning, manipulation, and seduction.
